summary: Tested bulk-upsert endpoint and Telemetría IA UI features for LUIGGI HOME. All features working correctly: 1) Backend bulk-upsert creates new products or updates zonePoints for existing ones, 2) Frontend shows library selector (ZC/MV) and tariff dropdown (T1-T21 for MV, Z1-Z12 for ZC), 3) api.js bulkUpsert handles responses correctly without 'body stream already read' error.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend bulk-upsert endpoint (server.py lines 1781-1867) correctly implements UPSERT logic: creates new products or merges zonePoints for existing ones
Backend converts product codes to uppercase (line 1798) for consistent matching
api.js bulkUpsert (lines 323-346) uses response.text() + JSON.parse() to avoid 'body stream already read' error
SettingsModal.jsx Telemetría IA section (lines 4469-4700) correctly shows library selector and dynamic tariff dropdown
seed_data_creation: Test products created and cleaned up during pytest execution (21 test products deleted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk-upsert endpoint tested and working. When importing products with different tariffs (T1, T2, T3 for MV), the zonePoints are correctly merged. The Telemetría IA UI in MASTER > Telemetría IA tab shows library selector (ZC/MV) and tariff dropdown.

1_bulk_upsert_endpoint.details: POST /api/products/bulk-upsert creates new products or updates zonePoints for existing ones. Tested with MV library (T1-T21) and ZC library (Z1-Z12). zonePoints correctly merge when importing different tariffs.

2_telemetry_ia_library_selector.details: SettingsModal shows 'LIBRERÍA DE CATÁLOGO' section with ZC (blue) and MV (purple) buttons. Clicking switches the active library.

3_telemetry_ia_tariff_dropdown.details: When MV selected: dropdown shows 'Tarifa MV' with T1-T21 options (21 total). When ZC selected: dropdown shows 'Zona ZC' with Z1-Z12 options (12 total).

4_api_js_body_stream_fix.details: bulkUpsert method in api.js uses response.text() + JSON.parse() instead of response.json() to avoid 'body stream already read' error.

api_tests.bulk_upsert_create: POST /api/products/bulk-upsert - 200 OK, creates new products with specified tariff
api_tests.bulk_upsert_update: POST /api/products/bulk-upsert - 200 OK, updates existing products with new tariff
api_tests.bulk_upsert_merge_zonepoints: Verified zonePoints merge correctly: {T1: 100, T2: 120, T3: 140}
api_tests.bulk_upsert_no_duplicates: Verified no duplicate products created when importing same codes

telemetry_ia_section.file_upload: CARGAR FICHAS area for JPG, PNG, PDF
